message: feat(unified): U08 四worker共享CPU池与HUNet GELU等价
rulings: U08 preserves original four ranges and erf expression; same target libm yields frozen A53 bitwise equality on13 real inputs. Host libm differences remain separately recorded, not threshold relaxation.
CPU cancellation drains all ranges and suppresses successful publication. Request terminal-state no-resurrection is owned and must be tested by U09, not claimed from pool alone.
Use one process PendingBudget32 for CPU/GPU/opaque. U09 must transfer reservation ownership and must not charge a second logical task at dispatch.
U08 requires one process-wide four-worker cap. Failed join retains state and worker slots until process exit; no inferred quiescence.
User explicitly requests faster verification. Reuse identity-matching objects/dependencies and batch independent checks within current C/resource gates; do not waive worker1 or necessary checks.
